result.description: Compact consumer flash storage device with a reversible USB-C connector and integrated USB-A adapter for cross-platform file transfer. Designed for everyday document, photo, and media backup with a lightweight plastic-and-aluminum shell. Supports USB 3.2 Gen 1 performance, encrypted folder access through optional software, and plug-and-play compatibility with Windows, macOS, and Android devices.
result.title: Orchard Pulse 64GB USB-C Dual Interface Flash Vault
